acquisition.method: git init; sparse-checkout (no-cone) of the listed patterns; fetch --depth 1 --filter=blob:none of the commit; checkout. A first, wider checkout that included data/legacy and the non-English folders was deleted and re-cloned narrowly because data/legacy carries a Lexham English Bible verse file (org_nt_LEB.txt) and its catalog names ESV, CSB, LEB and NET alignments; none of those bytes are in this checkout. data/catalog.tsv is a Git LFS object fetched through the LFS batch API and verified against its oid.

coverage.scope: English: BSB (SBLGNT-BSB NT 115,008 records; BGNT-BSB NT 115,992; WLCM-BSB OT 270,398) and YLT (SBLGNT-YLT NT 127,902; WLC-YLT OT 437,255), all manual, Scripture Burrito 0.3
coverage.counting_rule: len(records) of each data/eng/alignments/*/*.json; tokens here means alignment records summed over the five files; BSB is covered for both testaments
